baseline_models.mechanism: The coordinated first-person verbs make withdrawal and invocation one operation: Abraham leaves a human-idolatrous field of address and redirects speech, allegiance, and dependence to the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Literal setting-apart supplies the boundary; functionally it separates the speaker from the addressed community.
Calling by speech links their invocation, his invocation, and his prayer; functionally the repeated root marks a change of addressee.
Other-than marks the rival object field from which Abraham's call is withdrawn.
Lordship and ownership identify the sole authority to whom the redirected call belongs.

changed_reading.before: Abraham physically leaves his people and their gods, then prays instead.
changed_reading.after: The leaving is a selective reordering of address and dependence: he exits one field of invocation precisely by maintaining another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
baseline_models.mechanism: The hoped-for outcome is predicated of the speaker's condition, so prayer's success is not only receipt of an object but avoidance of a state of hardship through continuing relation to a nurturing Lord.

activation_trace.role: The spoken call supplies an ongoing relation rather than a one-time requested object.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the addressee one who tends the caller's condition.
Occurrence and presence in a state place the requested change at the level of Abraham's condition.
Hardship, difficulty, and toil define the condition from which the prayerful relation is hoped to preserve him.

changed_reading.before: Abraham hopes that a request to his Lord will be granted.
changed_reading.after: He hopes that sustained address to the Lord will keep his very condition from becoming one of hardship; relational access is itself part of the answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Threatened injury and commanded estrangement recast the focus withdrawal as an agency-preserving exit. Peace and promised intercession prevent the boundary from becoming reciprocal hostility, while prayer continues across the severed social bond.

activation_trace.role: Setting oneself apart supplies Abraham's deliberate boundary after another has ordered his removal.
Continued calling supplies speech that survives departure instead of being silenced by it.
Injurious speech imaged as stone-throwing supplies the coercive pressure surrounding the threatened act.
Rupture and parting supply the father's demanded severance that Abraham subsequently owns as his own action.
Peace opposed to war makes the exit nonretaliatory rather than a mirrored attack.
Covering the fault and shielding its bearer let concern for the father persist beyond separation.

structural_cues: 19:46 orders a prolonged severance immediately before 19:47 answers with peace and promised prayer, followed by the first-person withdrawal of 19:48.
The focus coordinates leaving and calling rather than making departure the end of speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, expulsion, peace, promised prayer, and then withdrawal; I infer that 19:48 converts imposed exclusion into a deliberate nonretaliatory boundary. Alternatively, the sequence may mark departure without implying a general strategy of de-escalation.

changed_reading.before: The withdrawal is a unilateral devotional choice to avoid false worship.
changed_reading.after: It is also a disciplined response to coercion: Abraham reclaims an imposed exile as his own boundary, refuses reciprocal hostility, and preserves prayerful concern across it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah enacts the focus pledge almost verbatim and immediately narrates unbought gifts, transformed status, and mercy. Apparent loss of household and cultic belonging becomes an opening into gifted kinship and prophetic continuity rather than sterile isolation.

activation_trace.role: Setting apart supplies the apparent social subtraction whose aftermath the next ayah narrates.
Nurture and completion give the redirected Lord-relation a capacity to sustain what follows the loss.
A gift given without counterpayment supplies relational abundance not purchased from the community Abraham leaves.
Causing something to assume a condition turns the gifted relations into a durable prophetic configuration.
The one who conveys from God makes the new kinship a continuation of communicative vocation, not merely private replacement.
The kinship branch latent in mercy binds divine giving to a renewed field of relation.

structural_cues: 19:49 repeats the focus sequence of withdrawal from them and what they worship besides God, but changes the pledge into completed action before narrating the gifts.
19:49-50 move from separation to descendants, prophethood, mercy, and elevated truthful mention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact verbal reprise followed by gift, kinship, and prophetic making; I supply the compensatory and generative arrow from severance to renewed relation. A live alternative is simple narrative succession rather than compensation or consequence.

changed_reading.before: Withdrawal is a necessary but socially costly subtraction followed by private prayer.
changed_reading.after: The enacted withdrawal becomes a threshold through which unbought kinship and communicative continuity arrive; separation is costly but not barren.

context_deltas.mechanism: Distance is selective rather than absolute: the speaker can be set apart from hostile kin and false addressees while remaining under attentive care, and the subsequent prophetic pattern places side-distance beside being brought near for confidential speech.

activation_trace.role: Being set in a separate side supplies one pole of the relational topology.
Nearness short of the true end supplies the inferior proximity of the abandoned objects.
Abiding, duration, and nearness make relation to the Lord persist despite social departure.
Attention, honor, and gentleness supply experienced care as the basis for confidence after leaving.
The branch extends side-position into estrangement and separation, preserving distance as a live spatial pole.
Literal nearness reverses isolation at the level of divine relation.
Confidential converse gives nearness a communicative form that answers the focus's redirected call.

structural_cues: 19:47 already grounds future prayer in the Lord's attentive care.
The later Moses portrait in 19:52 joins a side of the mountain, being brought near, and confidential converse in one compact movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attentive care and a later prophetic side-to-nearness pattern; I infer a topology in which distance from one addressee permits proximity to another. Alternatively, Moses's pattern may be locally specific and only analogical for Abraham.

changed_reading.before: Abraham moves away from people and idols toward solitary prayer.
changed_reading.after: His withdrawal redistributes proximity: distance from false and hostile relations coexists with abiding care and opens a model of intimate divine address.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative encloses Abraham's private redirection of speech within written remembrance and later grants an elevated truthful tongue. Leaving the immediate audience therefore does not erase his voice; it transfers speech from a rejecting household into durable public testimony.

activation_trace.role: The solitary traveler supplies the apparent loss of a social audience.
Vocal calling supplies the private speech whose later reach is transformed.
Mention running on the tongue turns the secluded speaker into one publicly voiced.
Ordered letters and the written object give that mention durable inscription.
Tongue as language and speech supplies the medium of Abraham's continuing public presence.
Truthful speech qualifies the transmitted voice as faithful testimony rather than mere fame.

structural_cues: 19:41 opens Abraham's scene by commanding his remembrance in the Book.
After 19:49 enacts his withdrawal, 19:50 grants an elevated tongue of truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies book-remembrance before the scene and elevated truthful speech after the departure; I infer the paradoxical transfer from rejected local address to durable public voice. Alternatively, these may be framing honors independent of the withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: Withdrawal removes Abraham from an audience so that he can address only his Lord.
changed_reading.after: The private call survives the rejected audience and is reissued as written remembrance and truthful public speech; leaving one hearing field enlarges another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The unarmed-person branch is a form-distant material image, so it is surprising and cannot define the lexical sense of أَعْتَزِلُ. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the adjacent threat followed by peace; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory disarmament analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَعْتَزِلُكُمْ under the threat-response sequence of 19:46-47

activation_trace.role: The literal branch image of a person without spear or weapon materializes withdrawal as relinquishing reciprocal force.
Harmful speech figured as pelting supplies an attack-like field against which being unarmed becomes functional.
Peacemaking against war supplies the nonviolent response that keeps the disarmament image contextually anchored.

changed_reading.before: Withdrawal means moving apart from the hostile group.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, withdrawal also means becoming 'unarmed': Abraham exits the exchange of verbal or physical missiles by answering threat with peace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milk-return, residual-milk, growth, and womb branches form a deliberately cross-domain agrarian analogy, not a claim that the focus words literally denote lactation or fertility. The reading remains anchored in three repeated focus roots and the immediate gifts after enacted separation; downstream prose must mark it as a material model of renewed provision.

activation_trace.role: A water outlet supplies a material image of separation as rerouting flow rather than merely stopping it.
Hope for milk to return after interruption makes possibility an image of provision resuming after a cut.
Milk deliberately retained to draw what follows images prayer as a small remaining relation that calls forth renewed supply.
Nourishment and growth give the Lord-relation a generative material role within the analogy.
Gift without exchange supplies the actual narrative return of provision after withdrawal.
The womb branch latent in mercy makes the ensuing descendants the analogy's concrete generative outcome.

changed_reading.before: Abraham cuts one relation and hopes that a separate prayer will receive an answer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cut reroutes rather than sterilizes relation: prayer remains like a retained starter through which nurture returns as gifted lineage.

strongest_changes: The threat-peace sequence recasts withdrawal as a self-authored, nonretaliatory boundary rather than mere retreat.
The exact enactment in 19:49, followed by gifts and mercy, turns apparent social loss into gifted relational and prophetic continuity.
Later nearness and confidential speech show how distance from one addressee can coexist with proximity to another.
summary.what_was_special: Three occurrences of د ع و bind rejected worship, Abraham's redirected call, and the hoped-for condition of the caller; the following ayah then repeats the withdrawal nearly verbatim before narrating its aftermath.
remaining_uncertainties: The compensatory arrow from withdrawal to gifts is reader-supplied; the packet guarantees sequence, not transaction.
Moses's nearness pattern may be analogical rather than directly explanatory of Abraham.
The unarmed and lactation readings depend on form-distant branch images and must remain exploratory.
